article_context: 认知与测量主题。先借 Marilyn vos Savant 的高 IQ 与现实问题形成反差，再解释 IQ 测试的形式、计分变化和预测边界；保持学术清晰，对‘测试分数不等于全部智能’这一中心观点加强信息重音。

article.title: 阅读二 · IQ 测试能测出什么
article.background: 认知与测量主题。先借 Marilyn vos Savant 的高 IQ 与现实问题形成反差，再解释 IQ 测试的形式、计分变化和预测边界；保持学术清晰，对‘测试分数不等于全部智能’这一中心观点加强信息重音。

sentences.en: For the past several years, the Sunday newspaper supplement Parade has featured a column called ‘Ask Marilyn.’
sentences.zh: 过去几年里，周日报纸增刊《Parade》一直设有一个名为“Ask Marilyn”的专栏。

segments.text: For the past several years, the Sunday newspaper supplement Parade has featured a column called ‘Ask Marilyn.’

sentences.en: People are invited to query Marilyn vos Savant, who at age 10 had tested at a mental level of someone about 23 years old; that gave her an IQ of 228—the highest score ever recorded.
sentences.zh: 读者可以向玛丽莲·沃斯·莎凡特提问；她10岁时测试出的心智能力相当于大约23岁的人，因此得到228的智商分数——这是有记录以来的最高分。

segments.text: People are invited to query Marilyn vos Savant, who at age 10 had tested at a mental level of someone about 23 years old; that gave her an IQ of 228—the highest score ever recorded.

sentences.en: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.
sentences.zh: 智商测试会要求你完成语言和图形类比，想象纸张折叠、剪裁后的样子，并推断数字序列等。

segments.text: IQ tests ask you to complete verbal and visual analogies, to envision paper after it has been folded and cut, and to deduce numerical sequences, among other similar tasks.

sentences.en: So it is a bit confusing when vos Savant fields such queries from the average Joe (whose IQ is 100) as, ‘What's the difference between love and fondness?’
sentences.zh: 因此，当莎凡特面对普通人——其智商通常为100——提出诸如“爱与喜欢有什么区别？”这样的问题时，就多少让人感到困惑。

segments.text: So it is a bit confusing when vos Savant fields such queries from the average Joe (whose IQ is 100) as, ‘What's the difference between love and fondness?’

sentences.en: Or what is the nature of luck and coincidence?
sentences.zh: 或者：“运气与巧合的本质是什么？”

segments.text: Or what is the nature of luck and coincidence?

sentences.en: It's not obvious how the capacity to visualize objects and to figure out numerical patterns suits one to answer questions that have eluded some of the best poets and philosophers.
sentences.zh: 很难看出，想象物体形状和识别数字规律的能力，为什么就能使一个人适合回答那些连最优秀的诗人和哲学家都未能解决的问题。
prosody_focus: eluded some of the best poets and philosophers

segments.text: It's not obvious how the capacity to visualize objects and to figure out numerical patterns suits one to answer questions that have eluded some of the best poets and philosophers.

sentences.en: Clearly, intelligence encompasses more than a score on a test.
sentences.zh: 显然，智力所包含的内容远不止测试中的一个分数。

segments.text: Clearly, intelligence encompasses more than a score on a test.

sentences.en: Just what does it mean to be smart?
sentences.zh: 那么，聪明究竟意味着什么？
prosody_focus: what does it mean to be smart

segments.text: Just what does it mean to be smart?

sentences.en: How much of intelligence can be specified, and how much can we learn about it from neurology, genetics, computer science and other fields?
sentences.zh: 智力究竟有多少可以被明确界定？我们又能从神经学、遗传学、计算机科学及其他领域中了解它多少？

segments.text: How much of intelligence can be specified, and how much can we learn about it from neurology, genetics, computer science and other fields?

sentences.en: The defining term of intelligence in humans still seems to be the IQ score, even though IQ tests are not given as often as they used to be.
sentences.zh: 尽管如今智商测试已不像过去那样频繁使用，但衡量人类智力时最具代表性的指标似乎仍是 IQ 分数。
prosody_focus: still seems to be the IQ score

segments.text: The defining term of intelligence in humans still seems to be the IQ score, even though IQ tests are not given as often as they used to be.

sentences.en: The test comes primarily in two forms: the Stanford-Binet Intelligence Scale and the Wechsler Intelligence Scales (both come in adult and children's versions).
sentences.zh: 这类测试主要有两种形式：斯坦福—比奈智力量表和韦氏智力量表，两者都分别有成人版和儿童版。

segments.text: The test comes primarily in two forms: the Stanford-Binet Intelligence Scale and the Wechsler Intelligence Scales (both come in adult and children's versions).

sentences.en: Generally costing several hundred dollars, they are usually given only by psychologists, although variations of them populate bookstores and the World Wide Web.
sentences.zh: 这类测试通常费用高达数百美元，而且一般只有心理学家才能施测，尽管它们的各种变体在书店和互联网上随处可见。

segments.text: Generally costing several hundred dollars, they are usually given only by psychologists, although variations of them populate bookstores and the World Wide Web.

sentences.en: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100.
sentences.zh: 像莎凡特那样的超高分如今已不可能出现，因为现在的计分依据是同龄人群中的统计分布，而不再只是用心理年龄除以实际年龄再乘以100。

vocab.meaning: a. 年代学的；按时间顺序的

segments.text: Superhigh scores like vos Savant's are no longer possible, because scoring is now based on a statistical population distribution among age peers, rather than simply dividing the mental age by the chronological age and multiplying by 100.

sentences.en: Other standardized tests, such as the Scholastic Assessment Test (SAT) and the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), capture the main aspects of IQ tests.
sentences.zh: 其他标准化考试，如学术能力评估考试（SAT）和研究生入学考试（GRE），也涵盖了智商测试的主要方面。

segments.text: Other standardized tests, such as the Scholastic Assessment Test (SAT) and the Graduate Record Exam (GRE), capture the main aspects of IQ tests.

sentences.en: Such standardized tests may not assess all the important elements necessary to succeed in school and in life, argues Robert J. Sternberg.
sentences.zh: 罗伯特·J·斯滕伯格指出，这类标准化测试未必能评估一个人在学校和生活中取得成功所需要的全部重要因素。
prosody_focus: succeed in school and in life

segments.text: Such standardized tests may not assess all the important elements necessary to succeed in school and in life, argues Robert J. Sternberg.

sentences.en: In his article ‘How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?’, Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.
sentences.zh: 斯滕伯格在《智力测试究竟有多“智能”？》一文中指出，传统测试最擅长衡量分析能力和语言能力，却无法测量创造力和实践知识，而后两者同样是解决问题和获得人生成功的关键要素。

vocab.meaning: a. 分析的；善于分析的

prosody_focus: best assess analytical and verbal skills
fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge

segments.text: In his article ‘How Intelligent Is Intelligence Testing?’, Sternberg notes that traditional tests best assess analytical and verbal skills but fail to measure creativity and practical knowledge, components also critical to problem solving and life success.

sentences.en: Moreover, IQ tests do not necessarily predict so well once populations or situations change.
sentences.zh: 此外，一旦受测人群或情境发生变化，智商测试的预测效果就未必那么可靠。
prosody_focus: do not necessarily predict so well

segments.text: Moreover, IQ tests do not necessarily predict so well once populations or situations change.

sentences.en: Research has found that IQ predicted leadership skills when the tests were given under low-stress conditions, but under high-stress conditions, IQ was negatively correlated with leadership—that is, it predicted the opposite.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，在低压力条件下进行测试时，IQ 能预测领导能力；但在高压力条件下，IQ 与领导能力却呈负相关——也就是说，它预测出了相反的结果。

vocab.meaning: 有相互关系的东西；相关物

segments.text: Research has found that IQ predicted leadership skills when the tests were given under low-stress conditions, but under high-stress conditions, IQ was negatively correlated with leadership—that is, it predicted the opposite.

sentences.en: Anyone who has toiled through SAT will testify that test-taking skill also matters, whether it's knowing when to guess or what questions to skip.
sentences.zh: 任何苦熬过 SAT 的人都会证明，应试技巧同样重要，比如知道什么时候该猜、哪些题该跳过。

segments.text: Anyone who has toiled through SAT will testify that test-taking skill also matters, whether it's knowing when to guess or what questions to skip.
